newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway March CPI rises 0.3 pct mnth/mnth.
newsitem.headline: Norway March CPI rises 0.3 pct mnth/mnth.

text.p: Statistics Norway (SSB) issued the following economic indicator.
NORWAY CONSUMER PRICES MAR 1997 FEB 1997 MAR 1996
NOTE -- Ten economists polled by Reuters forecast a year-on-year rise in March of 3.15 percent and for inflation to increase by an average 0.35 percent month-on-month.

SSB attributed the month-on-month rise mainly to higher property rental prices and increased prices for clothes, shoes, food and gasoline. Countering the increase were lower prices for electricity, paraffin and heating oil, SSB said.
